trigger.about: pyarrow.csv.read_csv/open_csv with ParseOptions(newlines_in_values=True) on a >1 MiB file whose quoted values contain CRLF line breaks

summary: pyarrow's CSV reader silently drops the LF of a CRLF inside a quoted field when the CR is the last byte of a parse block (default block 1 MiB), so a multi-line value loses one byte
